lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We all should

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: hold a sports competition too!
That sounds fun.
Kinda sounds like it'd be a pain.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It'd be a total blast!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'm so excited to try it,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: that I can't stop grinning!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I don't see what'd be so hard about it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: All of our jobs are labor-intensive,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: so a sports competition would be perfect!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: A sports competition?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Where'd you get this idea from all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Isn't it obvious?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: She probably saw it in one of her anime shows.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How'd you know?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ah!!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Did you also see that episode

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: of Brave Pedal last night?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What on earth are you talking about?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It's this anime that's trending right now.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It's about female cycling competitions.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It airs at midnight,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: and last night's episode was all about a big cycling race.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What the...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: How do you know all this?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Are you a fan of the show as well?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: O-of course not!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It's just that my subordinates are always watching it,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: and every once in a while, I overhear what's going on in the show.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Just admit that you love the show.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Anyways, let's do this!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Each of our organizations can be a team,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: and Cadet can be the referee.
Huh? Me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Oooh, Mister will be participating too?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Now it's a little more tempting.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: If {AccountData.NickName}-kun is the referee, then I'm in.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: That way

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: we can consider it a teambuilding exercise.
I haven't agreed to anything yet...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: are you in or out?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hurry up and make a decision.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Scared that you're gonna lose,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Rosanna?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You must be.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Otherwise, why would you be running from my challenge?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You think I'm refusing

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: out of fear I might lose?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Don't make me laugh.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: If it's not that,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: then it must mean you don't have enough faith in your subordinates.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Listen, you two morons,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll show you what happens to those who doubt me.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Give me a time and a place,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: and I'll be there.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Just don't come crying to me later and try to bail out.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Oh trust me, that won't happen.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Darn right it won't!
